name: Brisbane Festival concession tickets
summary: Brisbane Festival offers concession tickets to full-time students on many productions.
catches: Discounts vary by production; check each event page.
The festival runs each September, so offers apply to the next festival.

evidence.quote: Concession – For full-time students, pension card holders, healthcare card holders, or seniors card holders.
